name: refusal-declined
description: Shop refuses to quote over the phone. The call must end as a documented decline with no quote fabricated.

transcript.message: Hi, this is WrenchBid, an AI assistant phoning on behalf of a customer. I need an itemized quote for a confirmed scope: 2020 Toyota Camry SE, 62,000 miles, replace front brake pads and rotors with premium aftermarket parts, Charlotte, North Carolina 28202, completion within 7 days.
We don't do phone quotes. We won't provide pricing until the car is on the lift.
Understood. The customer has a confirmed written scope — is there any itemized estimate you can share from that?
Understood — I'll record that as a decline to quote. Thank you for your time.
